statusHistory.note: Operator-commissioned (West Hollywood/LA hip-spots war room, 2026-11-04), second pin in the cluster after Trunks. Verified open via live Google Maps listing (4.3/572 reviews, closed-until-7pm at time of check, consistent with its normal evening-only hours) and claude-in-chrome for exact coordinates. Research floor: Time Out, The Infatuation, Netflix Is a Joke Fest (comedy booking page), Viberate, filmwesthollywood.com location guide, naicslist.com business registry — six preferred-source-type consults, exceeding the five-source floor. Reddit leg: site:reddit.com search returned no usable threads on this venue specifically — logged as a floor gap, not fabricated. Google reviews leg: read live via claude-in-chrome; recent reviews quoted/paraphrased honestly (acoustics praised twice independently, a comedy-night visit with photobooth, an indie-music-showcase night) with no notable recent negative pattern found. Totally!, the venue's long-running Wednesday indie standup showcase, is real and current per multiple ticketing sources (Netflix Is a Joke Fest, Feverup) but no single confirmed upcoming date could be verified this session beyond 'Wednesdays, ongoing through 2026' — too vague to set as eventStartsAt per the no-invented-dates rule, so it's described in-body as recurring weekly programming rather than nested as a dated event. Named origin story (Sean McPherson with manager Jared Meisler; named for filmmaker Ernst Lubitsch; sits in WeHo's Russian-speaking Santa Monica Blvd stretch) is real texture from Time Out/BizBash, not invented. Hero image is a real operator-sourced photo but under the Discover pixel spec (414x310) — used anyway per licenseNote, flagged for a resolution upgrade rather than holding the piece. Full six-locale coverage done inline, single coordinator, no subagents, per the operator's standing token-efficiency directive. Headline leads with a concrete USP (comedy/cabaret stage + vodka bar, not a generic WeHo bar) and avoids the 'The X that Y' construction per operator instruction.
